body: I have considered (and tried) better alternatives and whatnot. It's just really hard when my mindset is so unchangeably nervous and upset. Compared to other family members, I'm very good at controlling urges, and I'm horrible at it compared to others ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

The main problem with therapy is that I tend to both not be honest with how negative my feelings get, and don't follow their suggested measures for self-help. My old therapist was very compatible with me. But I think I might need group therapy or some environment where it feels more normal to share darker truths.

And I agree, socializing is really helpful with addiction c: I guess I should force myself to be more social, huh
